soldier: Head of the soldier brownish yellow, the frons slightly darker, mandibles blackish brown and slightly paler at the base, labrum deep yellow, antennae yellow. Pronotum pale yellowish brown with the anterior margin slightly darker, the tibiae and tarsi slightly darker. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle a small circular dot, generally not rising above the surface of the vertex; the frontal slope appears rather steep. Labrum semicircular, wider than long, bearing two long hairs and seven or eight short hairs on its surface, the anterior margin with more than ten long hairs. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apex rather slender and slightly curved, the outer margin smooth and slightly wavy near the base; the left mandible 0.65–0.71 of the head capsule; behind the middle of the inner margin of each upper mandible there is one minute tooth. Antennae 14 segments, the second short and small, the third stouter and longer, about twice the second. Postmentum slender and long, in profile its middle slightly arched beyond the lower margin of the head. Anterior margin of the pronotum rather deeply concave centrally, the angle of the notch about 130°, the lateral margins converging obliquely posteriorly, the surface slightly behind the anterior margin with two V-shaped depressions, the posterior margin narrow and almost without a central notch. Femora rather stout, tibiae rather slender.
